stories.headline: Ukrainian drones stray into Finnish airspace, sparking diplomatic and security response
stories.summary: Multiple Ukrainian attack drones targeting Russian facilities strayed into Finnish territory over several days, landing near Kouvola, Luumäki, and Parikkala. Prime Minister Orpo held press conferences addressing the incidents, while Finland enhanced air surveillance and communicated with both Ukraine and NATO allies about the territorial violations.

stories.headline: President Stubb conducts high-profile diplomatic calls with Trump and Iran's president
stories.summary: President Alexander Stubb held separate phone calls with US President Donald Trump about NATO cooperation and with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian about the Middle East crisis. Stubb emphasized Europe's growing responsibility in NATO to Trump while urging Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Finance Minister Purra reveals PM ambitions and plans for deeper spending cuts
stories.summary: Finance Minister Riikka Purra announced her intention to become Prime Minister while outlining plans for additional spending cuts targeting pensions and agricultural subsidies. In an interview, Purra also criticized housing benefit fraud by left-wing politicians and stated the government should have made more severe cuts during coalition negotiations.

stories.headline: Stubb falls ill, forcing cancellation of Moldova president's visit
stories.summary: President Alexander Stubb contracted a viral infection, forcing the cancellation of a scheduled working visit by Moldova's President Maia Sandu to Finland. The meeting was to discuss bilateral relations, the war in Ukraine, and Moldova's EU accession process.

articles.title: Stubb sairastui – Moldovan presidentin vierailu peruuntui

stories.headline: Defense Minister manages drone crisis remotely from Spanish vacation
stories.summary: Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen was on family vacation in Spain when the Ukrainian drone incidents began but managed the crisis remotely, coordinating with security authorities and his Ukrainian counterpart. Häkkänen communicated with Ukraine's Defense Minister about preventing future incidents.

stories.headline: Opposition files interpellation motion on poverty and rising living costs
stories.summary: The Left Alliance filed an interpellation motion against the Orpo government over deepening poverty and rising living costs, with the Greens joining the motion. The opposition criticized government spending cuts and demanded action to address what they termed a 'poverty crisis.'

articles.title: Vasemmistoliitolta välikysymys hallitukselle syvenevästä köyhyydestä ja elinkustannusten noususta

stories.headline: Finland repatriates minor from Iraq's al-Hol camp amid security concerns
stories.summary: Finnish authorities repatriated a minor Finnish boy from Iraq who had been held in Syria's al-Hol camp for seven years. SUPO noted that repatriations from conflict zones generally increase terrorism risks, though they declined to comment on the specific case.
